name: Rio de Janeiro
blurb: Rio de Janeiro remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
Easy to get around without a car
negative: Cheap accommodation getting harder to find

quotes.text: The food alone would be worth the trip.
Prices have crept up but it is still cheaper than the mainland.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
